        print(i, el.get('page_no'), repr(t))
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/APPLE_2020_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data['texts']
for start,end in [(8,22),(10,21),(12,20)]:
    print('RANGE',start,end)
    for i in range(start,end+1):
        el=texts[i]
        print(i, 'page', el.get('page_no'), 'text=', repr(el.get('text','')), 'label=', el.get('label'), 'structure=', el.get('structure'))
    print()
PY"
